description: Test file for the SessionData module in the OpenClaw project, containing unit tests for session kind classification, token statistics formatting, and session row flags.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Tests the detection of session kinds based on key strings.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected

methods.description: Ensures that session row flag labels correctly include non-default flags.
